resolution: Implemented both requested editor corrections. Solidify now collapses render triangles by authored face group, derives one area-weighted plane per quad/ngon, and solves the inward offset-plane intersection at each welded vertex, giving a cube an exact uniform shell independent of its triangulation diagonals. Focused Zig tests cover the triangulated cube and planar panel. Adding a primitive Outliner row now synchronously collapses selection to the new row and pushes its host range through the same complete focus path as Duplicate; the headless audit confirms the appended Cube 2 is selected, primary, and owns all six selected authored faces. ReleaseFast editor build passes.
